vehicles.open.tooltip: Edit the vehicle groups of the map: depots with their buses, and groups of vehicles for tours and traffic.
vehicles.title: Vehicles and depots
vehicles.description: A tour names a vehicle group. A depot lists vehicle types with the fleet numbers and plates of their buses; a plain group lists vehicles with a weight for random traffic. Every change is one undo step.
vehicles.empty: The map has no vehicle groups yet. Make a depot for buses or a group of vehicles.
vehicles.new_depot.tooltip: Make a depot: a name, a first vehicle type and the depot file of that bus.
vehicles.new_pool.tooltip: Make a plain group of vehicles that random traffic and tours can use.
vehicles.name: Name
vehicles.hof.hint: Depots found next to the vehicle: {names}
vehicles.delete.tooltip: Take the group out of the file. Not possible while a tour names it.
vehicles.none_found: No vehicle of the installation matches.
vehicles.create.tooltip: Add the group to the map's vehicle lists.
vehicles.depot_empty: This depot has no vehicle type yet, so no bus would run for it. Add one below.
vehicles.type.remove.tooltip: Remove this vehicle type with all its buses from the depot.
vehicles.type.add.tooltip: Add the chosen vehicle to the depot as a new type, without buses.
vehicles.bus.add.tooltip: Add a bus of this type with the next fleet number.
vehicles.day.tooltip: A day as YYYYMMDD, or empty
vehicles.pool.add.tooltip: Add the chosen vehicle to the group.
vehicles.weight.tooltip: How often traffic picks this vehicle among the others of the group
vehicles.status.failed: The vehicle groups could not be changed: {reason}
